The '''Yucrales sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
When [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] faked his death in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], he and his aide, [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]], hid out in the Yucrales sector aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Cobra]]''. However, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Thune (bounty hunter)|Thune]] tracked them there and tried to capture them with her ship, the [[Starlight Red|''Faceted'']].
